verdict: Google Business Profile went dark this week across all three locations.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, the Google Business Profile listings were your only active source of customer engagement this period — paid advertising has been dormant on all channels. Combined, the three listings produced 375 total actions over the last 28 days (directions, web clicks, and calls), but all three dropped to zero actions in the past seven days, a confirmed outage that is being investigated and resolved as the immediate priority. Separately, several workstream items due August 31 — including account reconciliation, contact list pulls for outreach, and a web/SEO fix submission — remain outstanding, which is delaying the launch of email and calling programs. Those blockers are being cleared this week so outreach can begin and search visibility work can move forward.
